key_insight: Detonation-spray parameters can tune the roughness, thickness, and hydrophobicity of titanium-dioxide-based metal–ceramic coatings.
engineering_relevance: The reported relationships can guide nozzle-speed and spray-distance selection to target coating geometry and maximize water repellency.
method: Vary detonation-spraying conditions for titanium-dioxide-based coatings.
Evaluate surface roughness, coating thickness, and contact angle.
Derive predictive equations and identify conditions for maximum hydrophobicity.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports inverse-power relationships of roughness and thickness with nozzle passage speed, and parabolic relationships of roughness and contact angle with spray distance.
watch_item: The abstract provides no numerical parameter ranges, contact angles, or prediction errors, limiting assessment of performance and transferability.
paper_title: Surface Characteristics of Titanium Based Coatings Obtained by Detonation Spraying Under Various Process Conditions
